pooled_portfolio.entity: a CRSP holdings portfolio shared by one or more fund share classes

share_class.entity: a CRSP fund/share-class contract with its own TNA history

etf_security.entity: the exchange-traded security representing a verified ETF share class
etf_security.source_status: requires a separately validated fund-to-security link

underlying_security.entity: the security held in a pooled portfolio position
underlying_security.fallback_key: cusip plus effective date only under a separately registered mapping rule

underlying_position.entity: one source holdings row, including positions without a Stock permno
underlying_position.construction: holding source-file SHA-256 plus zero-based raw row number

economic_date.entity: the as-of date of the holdings snapshot
economic_date.tna_key: monthly_tna.caldt under the frozen same-economic-month-end alignment rule

availability_timestamp.usable_date_construction: first calendar date strictly after the maximum eff_dt across all rows in a portfolio/report snapshot
availability_timestamp.precision: eff_dt has date precision only; an intraday timestamp is not present

holdings.row_unit: one pooled-portfolio source position identified canonically by source-file SHA-256 and zero-based raw row number; crsp_portno, report_dt, and security_rank are retained descriptors

market_val.raw_reconciliation: nbr_shares times the latest CRSP absolute price on or before report_dt, with a maximum three-calendar-day gap

percent_tna.denominator: total net assets of the pooled crsp_portno portfolio

availability.definition: date CRSP received the holdings information from its vendor
availability.snapshot_rule: use the maximum eff_dt across rows because the full snapshot cannot be considered available before its last received component

monthly_tna.row_unit: one crsp_fundno share class at month end
monthly_tna.definition: assets minus liabilities at month end
monthly_tna.portfolio_aggregation: sum exact-date mtna over the complete unique set of validly mapped, economically active classes; exclude a map-only class only when effective historical records affirmatively show it was inactive, and reject the denominator if any active class TNA is missing

portfolio_map.row_unit: one effective-dated crsp_fundno to crsp_portno relationship
portfolio_map.endpoint_rule: inclusive at both ends as a frozen specification choice

fund_header_history.et_flag_caveat: F can be carried over historical records and is not sufficient by itself to date an MF-to-ETF transition

relationship_contract.holdings_to_share_classes: effective-dated many-to-one mapping from crsp_fundno share classes to crsp_portno pooled portfolio
relationship_contract.pooled_portfolio_tna: sum of correctly dated active share-class TNA, never one arbitrary class and never a stale quarterly summary
relationship_contract.etf_class_exposure: portfolio position weight multiplied by correctly dated ETF share-class TNA
relationship_contract.pro_rata_gate: no ETF-class dollar exposure unless the class is a verified pro-rata claim on the pooled portfolio
relationship_contract.multi_class_evidence: date-scoped POOLED_MULTICLASS_PRO_RATA evidence: effective mapping and security crosswalk, contemporaneous SEC same-Fund class evidence, relative-net-assets or respective-NAV allocations, no separate sleeve, exact-date complete class TNA, and accounting identity
relationship_contract.single_class_evidence: date-scoped SINGLE_CLASS_UIT_PRO_RATA evidence: SEC proportionate undivided interests in one trust portfolio, sole economically active mapped class, exact-date class TNA equal to pooled TNA within tolerance, effective ETF-security crosswalk, and accounting identity

date_contract.same_economic_date: monthly_tna.caldt must equal report_dt exactly; nearest-date and business-month-end substitutions are prohibited
date_contract.holdings_no_lookahead: snapshot is ineligible until the first calendar date strictly after max(eff_dt)
date_contract.market_value_price_alignment: latest trading date on or before report_dt, with a maximum three-calendar-day gap
date_contract.publication_delay_days: max(eff_dt) minus report_dt, recorded separately from report age
date_contract.tna_point_in_time_restriction: monthly TNA may validate accounting identities retrospectively but may not support an availability-sensitive claim until its publication timestamp or a validated registered lag is supplied

primary_evidence.source: CRSP Survivor-Bias-Free US Mutual Fund Database Guide
primary_evidence.supports: portfolio and fund identifiers; holdings row/date fields; percent_tna denominator; market_val definition; monthly TNA units; effective portfolio mapping
fundno TNA is share-class TNA and must be summed to portfolio TNA

primary_evidence.source: SEC 2024 Vanguard 500 Index Fund filings and contemporaneous Vanguard Multiple Class Plan
primary_evidence.supports: same-Fund 2024 VOO/conventional classes, relative-net-assets allocation, equal rights to Fund assets and earnings, and exact-date one-portfolio accounting; used only for VOO on registered pilot dates

primary_evidence.source: SEC 2024 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust prospectus
primary_evidence.supports: SPY Units are proportionate undivided interests in one unit-investment-trust portfolio; used only for the registered SPY date

unresolved_fields: general historical fund-to-ETF-security mapping outside individually verified golden cases
amendment_rule: Any new formula, date cutoff, mapping rule, counterfactual, tolerance, source-field interpretation, or pro-rata criterion changes this contract/configuration and requires a new golden sample and pilot.
